browser.small_edit_feedback: p95 <=100 ms over at least30 matched select/stage/cancel/commit samples on the fixed host and browser
browser.bounded_canvas: For the admitted up-to32-node/64-edge family, p95 request-to-published-layout <=250 ms and no main-thread computation task >50 ms; test multiple graph shapes, long labels, fonts and cancellation
browser.responsive: No horizontal page overflow at320/390/640/1365/1440 CSS px; selected controls remain reachable at200% and400% zoom; labels must have a readable zoom/scroll alternative
browser.interaction_targets: Project minimum44x44 CSS px for primary buttons/inputs/disclosures; explicit computed accessible names and visible focus
browser.qualification_note: These are proposed acceptance budgets, not WCAG certification or established current performance results.

backend_performance.host_scope: Same coordinator host, release build, fixed workload and five samples; report raw ranges and median. Do not use the 20-second native controller timeout as a usability target.

F25.proposed_target: At most 2ms median for 1k and 20ms for 10k, with 10k/1k growth under20x; target is a local performance budget, not a SysON equivalence claim.

F27.workload: Fresh local candidate store; small and near1MiB document create/load/update; reject oversized aggregate batch before any SQL
F27.proposed_target: Warm local CRUD p95 under100ms for small documents and250ms for near1MiB documents; quantify process-startup overhead. Oversized batch additional planner/protocol memory should be O(8MiB budget plus one document), not O(64MiB input batch). All timings remain unmeasured in this read-only lane.

F31.proposed_target: Report operation phases and storage environment separately; do not promise fixed sub100ms durable publication across filesystems or imply power-loss qualification.

functional: Identity domains and resource/snapshot ownership must remain explicit; unresolved/unsupported inputs cannot be silently converted into success.
Staging, commit, cancel, undo/redo, failed import and failed SQL must retain documented model/representation/history boundaries.
Every native parity claim needs matched input/artifact/source/version evidence; isolated source-derived tests or a rendered reference screenshot do not close all behavior.
usability: Keep uncommitted form input during unrelated canvas actions and recoverable errors; retain a clear commit/cancel target.
Expose human-readable semantic hierarchy and progressive disclosure of relationships/advanced properties.
Maintain reachable keyboard focus, computed accessible names, readable status/error recovery, narrow-screen reflow and a readable diagram navigation mode.
release: Retarget dependent PRs after prerequisites land; inspect and revalidate actual merged composition.
Regenerate/check distribution policy against the real composed source and WASM; oldad814 package metadata is not a current release attestation.
Native persistence/session/security/build correspondence remains explicitly separate from localSQLite and source contracts.
